text:
We checked “Image Transformation Folder 2” and found 2 issues in the InDesign file that are likely causing the problems in Frontify. Here’s what to change:

1. Image frame is flipped or skewed
Frontify can’t reproduce flipped or skewed frames, so the image will look different or break when edited.
Where: the image “logo_KawaksakiMotorsCorp.USA_original.png” (pages 1–2)
• Select the image frame and choose Object > Transform > Clear Transformations (or set the shear angle to 0° and remove the flip).
Learn more

2. Linked image missing from the package
The document links to an image that isn’t in the package, so Frontify can’t show it.
Where: the image “logo_KawaksakiMotorsCorp.USA_original.png” (page 2)
• Relink any missing images in Window > Links.
• Package again with File > Package with "Copy Linked Graphics" checked.
Learn more

Once that’s done, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
